effects.label: Effects
effects.title: Shape your sound

filter.title: Filter
filter.description: Low-pass and high-pass, with a curve you can see.

echo.title: Echo

spectrum.title: Spectrum
spectrum.description: See your frequencies anywhere in the chain.

utility.title: Utility
utility.description: Gain, balance, stereo width, mono and phase.

themes.label: Themes

rust.title: Written in Rust

get.title: Download Tonique
get.early: You can already arrange, warp and mix audio, but recording, MIDI, plugins and automation aren't there yet, and you may run into bugs. Save your projects often.
get.mobile: Tonique runs on computers. Open this page on your Windows, macOS or Linux computer to install it.

steps.extract: Right-click the downloaded zip and choose Extract All.
steps.run: Open the extracted Tonique folder and double-click Tonique.exe.
steps.warning: Tonique isn't signed yet, so SmartScreen may warn you. Click More info, then Run anyway.

steps.drag: Open the .dmg and drag Tonique to Applications.
steps.launch: Open Tonique from Applications. It isn't notarized yet, so macOS will block it the first time: click Done.
steps.allow: Go to System Settings, then Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and click Open Anyway.

macos.older: On macOS 14 or earlier, you can instead right-click Tonique in Applications and choose Open.
macos.requirements: macOS 11 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.
macos.uninstall: Move Tonique from Applications to the Trash.

steps.extract: Extract the archive from the folder you downloaded it to.
steps.install: Run the installer. It installs Tonique for your user, in ~/.local.
steps.open: Open Tonique from your applications menu, or from a terminal.

linux.requirements: 64-bit (x86_64) with ALSA, which most desktops already have.
